entities.name: Query protein (405 aa)
observations: A 405-residue soluble enzyme-like protein with calculated molecular weight 44.3 kDa and theoretical pI 5.23.
Contains Pfam DHBP_synthase (PF00926.25) at positions 7-197 and GTP_cyclohydro2 (PF00925.26) at positions 206-372.
Shows 58.7-63.5% identity over 96.8-97.0% query coverage to reviewed RibBA homologs.
Most likely a bifunctional RibBA enzyme carrying out two early riboflavin-biosynthesis reactions.

source_tools.relevance: Sequence properties, Pfam domains, and homolog evidence

entities.name: RibBA
observations: Bifunctional riboflavin-biosynthesis protein combining 3,4-dihydroxy-2-butanone-4-phosphate synthase and GTP cyclohydrolase II activities.
Curated homologs Q0AXM5, A0Q3H7, and A9VG50 report Mg2+/Mn2+ binding and one Zn2+ per subunit.
Curated homologs place the protein in the cytosol and in the riboflavin biosynthetic process.

entities.name: Riboflavin biosynthesis
observations: RibBA catalyzes the first reaction in the riboflavin branch from D-ribulose 5-phosphate and the first GTP-derived reaction toward the pyrimidine precursor.
The pathway contributes to synthesis of riboflavin, precursor of FMN and FAD cofactors.

source_tools.relevance: Pathway and reaction annotations from reviewed homologs

entities.name: D-ribulose 5-phosphate cleavage
observations: Rhea RHEA:18457: D-ribulose 5-phosphate is converted to (2S)-2-hydroxy-3-oxobutyl phosphate, formate, and H+.
This reaction corresponds to 3,4-dihydroxy-2-butanone-4-phosphate synthase activity (EC 4.1.99.12).

source_tools.relevance: Candidate catalytic reaction and EC annotation

entities.name: GTP cyclohydrolase II reaction
observations: Rhea RHEA:23704: GTP is converted to a 2,5-diamino-6-hydroxy pyrimidine ribosyl-phosphate intermediate, formate, phosphate, and protons.
This reaction corresponds to GTP cyclohydrolase II activity (EC 3.5.4.25).

source_tools.relevance: Candidate catalytic reaction and EC annotation

entities.name: RibBA metal cofactors
observations: Reviewed homolog annotations report binding of two divalent metal ions, Mg2+ or Mn2+, and one Zn2+ per subunit.

The query sequence contains a conserved Cys-rich segment around positions 300-310 consistent with the metal-binding region reported for RibBA homologs, but direct metal binding is inferred from homology rather than experimentally demonstrated for this sequence.

source_tools.relevance: Cofactor annotations and query sequence context
